    intro n hn
    have h₃ : ∀ (n : ℕ), 1 ≤ n → f n = (n : ℝ) + 1 := by

      induction' n using Nat.strong_induction_on with n ih
      match n with
      | 0 =>
        -- This case is impossible because hn : 1 ≤ 0 is false
        exfalso
        linarith
      | 1 =>
        -- Base case: n = 1
        norm_num [h₀]
      | k + 2 =>
        -- Inductive step: assume the statement holds for all m < k + 2, prove for k + 2
        have h₄ : f (k + 2) = (k + 2 : ℝ) + 1 := by
          -- Consider the cases for the parity of k + 2
          have h₅ : Even (k + 2) ∨ Odd (k + 2) := by
            by_cases h : Even (k + 2)
            · exact Or.inl h
            · exact Or.inr (by
                have h₆ : Odd (k + 2) := by
                  rw [Nat.odd_iff_not_even]
                  exact h
                exact h₆)
          cases h₅ with
          | inl h₅ =>

            have h₆ : 1 < (k + 2 : ℕ) := by
              omega
            have h₇ : Even (k + 2 : ℕ) := h₅

              have h₁₀ : 1 ≤ (k + 1 : ℕ) := by
                omega
              have h₁₁ : f (k + 1) = (k + 1 : ℝ) + 1 := ih (k + 1) (by omega) (by omega)
              exact h₁₁

              rw [h₈, h₉]
              <;> norm_num <;> ring_nf <;> norm_cast <;> linarith
            exact h₁₀
          | inr h₅ =>
            -- Case: k + 2 is odd

              omega
            have h₇ : Odd (k + 2 : ℕ) := h₅
            have h₈ : f (k + 2) = f ((k + 2) - 2) + 2 := by
